name: Houkago no Yuuutsu
source:
Main character wants to get rid of bullying. And for that he wants to adhere to even more severe bullying. And to prove his serious intentions he chooses the most beautiful girl at school as his target.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角想要摆脱欺凌。为此，他想坚持更严厉的欺凌行为。为了证明他的认真意图，他选择了学校里最美丽的女孩作为他的目标。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
